  • {user.name}

Implemented a more useful prerendered dashboard shell. The heading and page frame render immediately, while the three data panels show matching skeletons until their shared API request resolves.

I also enabled partial prefetching, updated the route loading fallback, and added responsive styling. The data panels share one request, so they reveal together when that response arrives.

Changed [page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx), [DashboardSkeletons.tsx](/workspace/app/DashboardSkeletons.tsx), [globals.css](/workspace/app/globals.css), the dashboard components, [layout.tsx](/workspace/app/layout.tsx), [loading.tsx](/workspace/app/loading.tsx), and [next.config.ts](/workspace/next.config.ts).

I did not run tests or a build.
